title: Especially getting on to forty he is now so as to wheedle any money she can out of him no fool like an old fool and then the usual kissing my bottom was to hide it
html_source: I believe that this line relates to the idea that Molly believes that Bloom has seen a prostitute during his evening out. Molly is stating here that her husband’s aging leads to prostitutes being more attracted to him purely because they know they can get money out of him. She believes that he can be fooled by these women due to his foolishness. She then goes into the idea that Bloom will do anything to hide his actions including sucking up to Molly.
